name: WIRES National Grants Program

funder.name: WIRES (NSW Wildlife Information, Rescue and Education Service)

summary: Competitive one-off grants across four tiers for Australian wildlife carers, rescue organisations, environmental NGOs, community groups and consortia, supporting wildlife rescue and rehabilitation, habitat restoration and native species recovery projects of 6 to 12 months.

amount.note: Top tier for consortia; environmental NGOs and community groups up to 10,000, carers up to 1,000, rescue organisations up to 5,000

status.quote: Key dates for 2026 applications: Applications - Closed

applicant_types.quote: Tier 1: Individually Licensed Wildlife Rescuers and Carers (maximum $1,000) Tier 2: Licensed Wildlife Rescue and Rehabilitation Organisations (maximum $5,000) Tier 3: Environmental NGOs and Community Groups (maximum $10,000) Tier 4: Consortia/Multi-partner Collaborations (maximum $20,000)

geography.quote: Be located in and conduct activities within Australia

access.quote: eligible applicants are invited to apply

amount.quote: Tier 1: Individually Licensed Wildlife Rescuers and Carers (maximum $1,000) Tier 2: Licensed Wildlife Rescue and Rehabilitation Organisations (maximum $5,000) Tier 3: Environmental NGOs and Community Groups (maximum $10,000) Tier 4: Consortia/Multi-partner Collaborations (maximum $20,000)

pool.quote: A total funding pool of up to $200,000 is available across four tiers.
